name: NEXTIN, Inc.
summary: NEXTIN, Inc. manufactures defect inspection and metrology systems for semiconductor and display industries in South Korea. The company offers AEGIS wafer inspection systems that detect various defects, such as bridges, thinning, protrusion, footing, scratches, and particles in film, pattern-generation, planarization, ion implantation, and cleaning processes across semiconductor manufacturing sequences.
